The structure of Mg2Co12O24 (Mg(CoO2)6) crystallizes in the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166), with 38 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Co centers with octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mg adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors and O centers appear in both four- and six-coordinate environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 38 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between Co octahedra and between Co and Mg octahedra.
